title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.58
body_markdown:
* Added: Coding agent, an autonomous AI developer you can assign to any developer task.
* Added: Fold/unfold functionality for tools.
* Added: mcp.json supports input placeholder for sensitive information.
* Added: Support inline code review.
* Added: Open file tool to the Copilot chat conversation agent.
* Added: # context support for file/folder/tools.
* Added: UI optimization for inline completion.
* Added: UI optimization for tools management view.
* Added: Support tool annotations and clientInfo for MCP servers.
* Added: Update tool call result information.
* Added: Security confirm for sensitive file edits.
* Fixed: Mitigate syntax lagging.
* Fixed: Specify default model for api.
